ops.title: Final post-fix verification: ccx revocation and cc-interact replay
ops.body: Independent post-fix verification passed both bounded branches. The final ccx v2 binary fails closed after Codex policy revocation across forced and ordinary discovery outages while preserving Claude fallback; the context-root diagnostic is a baseline custom-roots-client limitation with no supported trigger in Codex 0.155.1 or proposed 0.156.1, both of which omit MCP roots capability. The frozen cc-interact changes preserve native startup success across failed or hanging notification replay, fence generations and shutdown, persist and restore only approved routing context, reload Orca hook credentials without persistence, and document loopback as a trusted local-native boundary. The attached report records hashes, commands, anchors, evidence, nine unsuppressed lint diagnostics, and limits.
